note: Limits and rules of the investment plan. The limits are monitored by the allocation model (models/igfinal/config.py); the buy and sell rules were set by the portfolio manager on 15 November 2026.
buy_criteria: Replica of the S&P 500 with beta close to 1: 50 of its largest companies without NVIDIA and Oracle, at index weights. Its job is to follow the index; it is not a bet.
Berkshire Hathaway is held at 10% of the fund as a hedge for a falling market (portfolio manager, 19 November); the replica fills the other 90%.
From 16 to 19 November a sleeve of 30% of the fund (AMD, ASML, MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, META, PLTR, BABA) was held for the Anthropic IPO; it was sold on 19 November.
Every order is approved by the portfolio manager and recorded in the trade log with its reason.
sell_criteria: On Friday 20 November the cash is invested and the fund is brought to its target weights, always fully invested.
From the following week the fund is brought back to its target weights every Friday before the open.
An order smaller than $10,000 (0.1% of the fund) is not placed: it costs a commission and changes almost nothing.
A breached limit on the dashboard is fixed before any other trade.
